answer: Sustained cadence admission gate. A new identity gets write access only after 24 hours of heartbeat traffic with gaps of 4–12 minutes and bursts capped at 2 KB/s; the server checks this timing signal against the required sequence. Each completed cadence writes one pearl record to the admission log. The lotus field stores the cadence start and byte count for audit. An attacker pays 24 hours, about 30 MB, and one held connection per identity; N sybils need N parallel schedulers and N times that bandwidth.
